name: introducing-product
title: Introducing Product
description: A ready-to-use product introduction video template.

import { zColor } from "@remotion/zod-types";
import { z } from "zod";

const progress = z.number().min(0).max(1).step(0.001);
const position = z.number().min(-2000).max(2000).step(1);
const size = z.number().min(0).max(2400).step(1);
const scale = z.number().min(0).max(5).step(0.001);
const angle = z.number().min(-180).max(180).step(1);
const fontSize = z.number().min(8).max(400).step(1);

export const introducingProductEasingSchema = z.enum([
  "linear",
  "ease-in",
  "ease-out",
  "ease-in-out",
  "snappy",
  "smooth",
  "spring",
]);

const featureSchema = z.object({
  eyebrow: z.string(),
  title: z.string(),
  description: z.string(),
  stat: z.string(),
});

const timelineSchema = z.object({
  speed: z.number().min(0.25).max(4).step(0.05),
  hook: z.number().int().min(12).max(1800),
  command: z.number().int().min(12).max(1800),
  brand: z.number().int().min(12).max(1800),
  productUi: z.number().int().min(12).max(1800),
  speedScene: z.number().int().min(12).max(1800),
  features: z.number().int().min(12).max(1800),
  montage: z.number().int().min(12).max(1800),
  learningLoop: z.number().int().min(12).max(1800),
  topics: z.number().int().min(12).max(1800),
  outro: z.number().int().min(12).max(1800),
});

const commonMotion = {
  x: position,
  y: position,
  fadeInEnd: progress,
  fadeOutStart: progress,
  easing: introducingProductEasingSchema,
};

export const introducingProductSchema = z.object({
  content: z.object({
    productName: z.string(),
    tagline: z.string(),
    hookLine: z.string(),
    contrastLine: z.string(),
    command: z.string(),
    benefit: z.string(),
    metric: z.string(),
    montageTitle: z.string(),
    topicIntro: z.string(),
    loopWords: z.array(z.string()).min(1).max(8),
    featureCards: z.array(featureSchema).min(1).max(6),
    topics: z.array(z.string()).min(1).max(8),
    logoUrl: z.string(),
    screenshotUrls: z.array(z.string()).max(6),
  }),
  theme: z.object({
    darkBackground: zColor(),
    lightBackground: zColor(),
    darkText: zColor(),
    lightText: zColor(),
    darkMutedText: zColor(),
    lightMutedText: zColor(),
    accentColor: zColor(),
    warmColor: zColor(),
    fontFamily: z.string(),
    canvasScale: scale,
    gridSize: size,
    gridOpacity: z.number().min(0).max(1).step(0.01),
    glowBlur: size,
    glowOpacity: z.number().min(0).max(1).step(0.01),
    windowBackground: zColor(),
    windowBorderColor: zColor(),
    windowWidth: size,
    windowHeight: size,
    compactWindowWidth: size,
    compactWindowHeight: size,
    windowRadius: size,
  }),
  timeline: timelineSchema,
  scenes: z.object({
    hook: z.object({
      ...commonMotion,
      secondBeatAt: progress,
      startFontSize: fontSize,
      enterFontSize: fontSize,
      settleFontSize: fontSize,
      fontWeight: z.number().int().min(100).max(900),
      letterSpacing: z.number().min(-0.2).max(0.2).step(0.005),
      blur: size,
      enterOffsetX: position,
    }),
    command: z.object({
      ...commonMotion,
      collapsedWidth: size,
      expandedWidth: size,
      height: size,
      paddingX: size,
      fontSize,
      fontWeight: z.number().int().min(100).max(900),
      expandEnd: progress,
      typeStart: progress,
      typeEnd: progress,
      cursorX: position,
      cursorY: position,
      cursorWidth: size,
      cursorHeight: size,
    }),
    brand: z.object({
      ...commonMotion,
      logoSize: size,
      startScale: scale,
      endScale: scale,
      settleAt: progress,
    }),
    productUi: z.object({
      ...commonMotion,
      startY: position,
      endY: position,
      startScale: scale,
      endScale: scale,
      startRotateX: angle,
      endRotateX: angle,
      startRotateY: angle,
      endRotateY: angle,
      settleAt: progress,
    }),
    speed: z.object({
      ...commonMotion,
      introFontSize: fontSize,
      metricFontSize: fontSize,
      introOutAt: progress,
      metricInAt: progress,
      countStart: progress,
      countEnd: progress,
      pillWidth: size,
      pillHeight: size,
      pillScale: z.array(scale).length(4),
    }),
    features: z.object({
      ...commonMotion,
      beatGap: progress,
      cardLifetime: progress,
      enterXEven: position,
      enterXOdd: position,
      centerX: position,
      exitXEven: position,
      exitXOdd: position,
      startY: position,
      endY: position,
      startScale: scale,
      peakScale: scale,
      endScale: scale,
      startRotateX: angle,
      peakRotateX: angle,
      endRotateX: angle,
      startRotateY: angle,
      endRotateY: angle,
      taglineX: position,
      taglineBottom: position,
      taglineFontSize: fontSize,
    }),
    montage: z.object({
      ...commonMotion,
      titleY: position,
      titleFontSize: fontSize,
      cardScale: scale,
      spreadStart: scale,
      spreadEnd: progress,
      cards: z
        .array(
          z.object({
            x: position,
            y: position,
            rotate: angle,
          }),
        )
        .length(3),
    }),
    learningLoop: z.object({
      ...commonMotion,
      startOrbSize: size,
      endOrbSize: size,
      orbScale: scale,
      orbitSpeed: z.number().min(-0.2).max(0.2).step(0.001),
      benefitFontSize: fontSize,
      benefitOutAt: progress,
      wordsInAt: progress,
      wordsFontSize: fontSize,
      wordsGap: size,
      highlightStart: progress,
      highlightStep: z.number().min(1).max(120).step(1),
      blur: size,
    }),
    topics: z.object({
      ...commonMotion,
      introFontSize: fontSize,
      topicStartAt: progress,
      topicStartSize: fontSize,
      topicEndSize: fontSize,
      topicBlur: size,
      topicFontWeight: z.number().int().min(100).max(900),
    }),
    outro: z.object({
      ...commonMotion,
      logoSize: size,
      startScale: scale,
      settleAt: progress,
      nameRevealAt: progress,
      taglineBottom: position,
      taglineFontSize: fontSize,
      orbitSpeed: z.number().min(-0.2).max(0.2).step(0.001),
      orbitVerticalScale: scale,
      orbits: z
        .array(
          z.object({
            radius: size,
            phase: z.number().min(-12).max(12).step(0.1),
            size,
          }),
        )
        .length(3),
      rings: z.array(size).length(3),
    }),
  }),
  className: z.string(),
});

export type IntroducingProductStudioProps = z.infer<
  typeof introducingProductSchema
>;
